m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Whooooo dares pester me? Help the Bumblers? Why shhhhould the wind care about the buzzzings of bees?
I'll thrassshh you and leave you bewildered! Whooooosh!
You are no helpless Bumbler but a portentous Spellbinder! Fine! I'll help you, if I must! Whooosh!
<ITALICS>The Whirlwind Elemental mutters, whinges, and groans, but he follows your commands. </ITALICS>
I have done your bidding, Spellbinder! Release me from your swwaaay!
<ITALICS>You release the Whirlwind Elemental and it roars off into freedom. </ITALICS>
I don't know how you did it, young worker, but you have saved the village from the dastardly Burrower attack!
Vile Burrower agents attacked the village and set the houses ablaze! The fire and smoke are too intense for us to put out!
Hey, you aren't tasked with anything. Do I have a job for you!
Go to the Khazri Cave and convince one of the Whirlwind Elementals to help us extinguish the Burning Houses!
This may be a good way to earn their trust, so we can learn more about the Burrowers in the region.
Get a Whirlwind Elemental from the Khazri Cave! Then use it to put out the Burning Houses!
